texts.arguments: 3. Sri Shukla, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel raised an objection that against the order impugned, the petitioner has got efficacious alternative remedy to file an appeal under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and as such the present writ petition is liable to be dismissed on the ground of statutory alternative remedy.
